votes.motion: MOVED TO AMEND THE AGENDA TO MOVE TO ITEM 8A, ADMINISTRATION OF THE OATH OF OFFICE FOR NEWLY ELECTED COUNCIL MEMBER ANGELA CHOBERKA. COUNCIL MEMBER NADOLSKI SECONDED THE MOTION,
MOVED TO APPROVE THE JOINT PROCLAMATION. MOTION WAS SECONDED BY COUNCIL MEMBER HYER,
MOVED TO ACCEPT THE FY2021 AUDIT REPORT FOR REVIEW. MOTION WAS SECONDED BY COUNCIL MEMBER NADOLSKI,
MOVED TO ACCEPT THE FY2021 CAFR FOR REVIEW. MOTION WAS SECONDED BY VICE CHAIR WHITE,
MOVED TO APPROVE THE APPOINTMENT OF JESSICA ADAMS TO THE OGDEN DIVERSITY COMMISSION, WITH HER TERM TO EXPIRE MARCH 7, 2023. MOTION WAS SECONDED BY VICE CHAIR WHITE,

MOVED TO APPROVE THE REAPPOINTMENTS OF CAMILLE COOK, PRISCILLA M. MARTINEZ, AND RONALD WHITE TO THE MARSHALL WHITE CENTER ADVISORY COMMITTEE, WITH THEIR TERMS TO EXPIRE OCTOBER 20, 2023. MOTION WAS SECONDED BY VICE CHAIR WHITE,
MOVED THE PUBLIC HEARING BE CLOSED. MOTION WAS SECONDED BY NADOLSKI,
MOVED RESOLUTION 2022-1 BE DENIED. MOTION WAS SECONDED BY VICE CHAIR WHITE,

MOVED THE JOINT RESOLUTION BE ADOPTED, AND THE CHAIR BE AUTHORIZED TO SIGN THE SAME. MOTION WAS SECONDED BY COUNCIL MEMBER NADOLSKI, WITH THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE: [ENTITLED: "A joint resolution of the Ogden City Mayor and the Ogden City Council supporting the revitalization and economic focus of the Utah Main Street Program."]
